frames.name: run_1
frames.motion: running to the right: the near leg (image right) reaching forward, the far leg kicked back with its heel high

frames.name: run_2
frames.motion: running: the legs passing under her, the near knee up, the far foot leaving the ground behind

frames.name: run_3
frames.motion: running: the far leg now reaching forward, the near leg pushing off behind

frames.name: run_4
frames.motion: running: the near leg kicked back with its heel high, the far foot planted ahead

frames.name: run_5
frames.motion: running: like frame 1 again, the body one square lower (the bounce)

frames.name: run_6
frames.motion: running: like frame 2, the body one square lower

frames.name: run_7
frames.motion: running: like frame 3

frames.name: run_8
frames.motion: running: like frame 4

frames.name: attack_1
frames.motion: drops into a low, wide lunge facing right: the near knee bent forward, the far leg stretched back; the cannon brought down level at her hip, the claw grip at her back, the maroon wing plates and the crystal reaching forward to the right (the muzzle)

frames.name: attack_2
frames.motion: the same lunge, a little lower, the cannon level and aimed right

frames.name: attack_3
frames.motion: the same lunge, steady, aiming along the cannon

frames.name: attack_4
frames.motion: FIRE: the same lunge, the cannon pushed back a square by the shot

frames.name: attack_5
frames.motion: recoil: her body rises, the cannon kicked up - the muzzle pointing up-right, the claw grip down at her hip

frames.name: attack_6
frames.motion: recovering: back into a lower stance, the cannon level again

frames.name: skill_1
frames.motion: crouched behind the cannon, swinging it down from her shoulder: the cannon diagonal, the claw grip up at her shoulder, the muzzle down-forward near her feet

frames.name: skill_2
frames.motion: still swinging: the cannon steeper, she rises

frames.name: skill_3
frames.motion: standing, the cannon pointing down-forward, both hands on it

frames.name: skill_4
frames.motion: FIRE: the cannon raised level at chest height, aimed straight right, the wing plates opening at the muzzle

frames.name: skill_5
frames.motion: the cannon level, the shot's recoil leaning her back a little

frames.name: skill_6
frames.motion: holding the cannon level, leaning back, the far foot back

frames.name: skill2_1
frames.motion: crouching low, the cannon held diagonally down in front of her

frames.name: skill2_2
frames.motion: crouching lower, gathering, the cannon still diagonal

frames.name: skill2_3
frames.motion: swinging the cannon up level, aimed right, still crouched

frames.name: skill2_4
frames.motion: FIRE: crouched, the cannon level and aimed right, pushed back by the shot

frames.name: skill2_5
frames.motion: standing up, the cannon swung down behind her near hip, the claw grip down, her far hand reaching out

frames.name: skill2_6
frames.motion: standing, the cannon held behind her at her side, back toward the idle

frames.name: ult_1
frames.motion: crouching low over the cannon, gathering

frames.name: ult_2
frames.motion: rising, lifting the cannon upright in front of her

frames.name: ult_3
frames.motion: CHARGE: standing tall, both arms out to the right holding the cannon level at shoulder height, the wing plates opening

frames.name: ult_4
frames.motion: CHARGE: the same, the cannon a little higher, the wings fully open

frames.name: ult_5
frames.motion: bringing the cannon down to her chest, aimed down-right

frames.name: ult_6
frames.motion: FIRE: the cannon level at her chest, aimed straight right, her feet set

frames.name: ult_7
frames.motion: firing: the same, the recoil leaning her back

frames.name: ult_8
frames.motion: firing: the same, holding

frames.name: hit_1
frames.motion: hit: flinching back, the body leaning back, the cannon pushed up against her shoulder

frames.name: dead_1
frames.motion: hit hard: staggering back, the cannon slipping from her hands

frames.name: dead_2
frames.motion: dropping to one knee, the cannon falling in front of her

frames.name: dead_3
frames.motion: on one knee, bent forward, the cannon lying on the ground in front

frames.name: dead_4
frames.motion: sinking lower, one hand on the ground

frames.name: dead_5
frames.motion: falling onto her side

frames.name: dead_6
frames.motion: lying on the ground, still, the cannon beside her
